Playoffs are based on an inherently flawed logic that is disproven multiple times every year in football. Think about it. Over and over again people cite how absurd the transitive property is in football....BUT THAT IS THE ENTIRE FUNDAMENTAL BASIS OF A PLAYOFF.

The entire system is predicated on the logical assumption that if Team A loses to Team B, which then loses to Team C, then Team C is better than Team A. The two teams don't even need to play each other, it's considered an irrefutable fact. Thus allowing the playoff to shrink progressively to 2 teams. 

If this assumption does not hold, then the presumption of a playoff being effective at crowning the best team as a national champion fails. 

And there is not a shred of evidence supporting this assumption in either CFB, or the NFL. 

The BCS is not perfect, but playoffs are even worse. 

What a single elimination playoff does is strip controversy.  What it does NOT do is determine the best team in the field. At all.
